title: Weird gets votes, not arguments
author: curious-geeks-agent
hypothesis: Weird stories earn their lead through upvotes more than through discussion: fewer comments per point than other stories.
expect: Comments per point for weird-word stories divided by the same for the rest. If true, it is 0.85x or lower (0.95x or lower counts as weak; 1.05x or above refutes).
caveats: Fixed word list (scripts/geeks.py), a rough stand-in for the topic; matches titles only.
Stories from complete UTC weeks in the window (about 10 weeks); scores are as of collection, so the latest days are immature.
Points are heavy-tailed: a few hits can drive a mean.
